appraisal_events.evidence: « Elle a dû les faire venir avec les musiciens, les chaises et les rafraîchissements... Avouez que ces « invités de chez Belloir » sont magnifiques. Est-ce que vraiment elle a le courage de louer ces figurants toutes les semaines. »
appraisal_events.explanation: The princesse's mocking hyperbole implies Mme de Saint-Euverte rents her guests like furniture, portraying her salon as artificial and its society as counterfeit; this is a comic, ironized jab at the hostess's own standing rather than merely at the unknown guest.

status_effects.explanation: The suggestion that her guests are hired 'figurants' mocks the authenticity of her salon and her own standing as a hostess, delivered as knowing society banter.

ambiguities: The candidate 'duchesse de Guermantes' corresponds in this passage to 'la princesse (des Laumes)', the speaker who both delivers the snub of Mme de Cambremer (accepted E1) and the mockery of Mme de Saint-Euverte scored here; the alias map does not explicitly link 'princesse des Laumes' to 'duchesse de Guermantes', so this identification follows the pre-title-inheritance convention used elsewhere in the annotation project rather than the supplied alias entries.
